answer: Require every agent identity to earn trust through a single, rate-limited inlet: a new identity must complete a sequence of verifiable, costly tasks before it can transact, and its reputation passes through a prism of peer attestations that refract one real history into many independent checks, so a flood of fake identities cannot ride the same tide of trust. Creating thousands of Sybils then costs thousands of separate work histories, while one honest identity pays that cost only once.
